verdict.rationale: The only programmatic surfaces in the evidence are the official Ente CLI, which per its Homebrew formula is limited to exporting data and decrypting Auth exports, and an `enteauth://search` deep link. No public API or OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), so UI parity is far from met. Missing for 10: a documented public API covering adding, editing, deleting, trashing, sharing and organizing codes; an API reference or OpenAPI spec; any evidence that CLI or API features match the UI.
